newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico GDP rises 7.6 pct in Q4, 5.1 pct in year.
newsitem.headline: Mexico GDP rises 7.6 pct in Q4, 5.1 pct in year.

text.p: Mexico's real gross domestic product (GDP) rose 7.6 percent in the fourth quarter compared to the same quarter a year earlier, the National Statistics Institute said on Wednesday.
It said that real GDP rose 5.1 in 1996 compared to the year earlier.
Farming, forestry and fishing rose 1.6 percent in the fourth quarter compared to the same period a year earlier.
The industrial sector rose 13.0 percent in the fourth quarter compared to the same period a year earlier.

Of that sector, mining rose 12.5 percent, manufacturing rose 12.7 percent, construction was up 17.8 percent, and power generation, electricity, gas and water rose 5.1 percent in the fourth quarter compared to the same period a year earlier, the government said.

The service sector rose 6.0 percent. Of that commerce, restaurants, and hotels rose 10.1 percent; transport, and communications rose 10.9 percent; financial services, insurances and real estate rose 3.0 percent; and communal services, rose 2.6 percent.
